::: {#sol-unseen}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
seen = pair_counts > 1
n_unseen = (~seen[val_ids[:-1], val_ids[1:]]).sum().item()
print(n_unseen)
```

`r py$n_unseen` of the `r format(length(py$val_ids) - 1, big.mark = ",")` pairs never occur in the training text.
Without the added ones,
the [bigram model](#def-bigram-model) would give each of them probability 0,
and so the whole validation text probability 0.

:::
